card.name: Enumerations and figure labels in old texts
card.fires_on: Punctuation or numbering that opens a list or figure label in old anatomy and scholarly texts, such as a colon after "consists of", "1st", or "FIG." before a number.

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: A colon or numeral starting an enumerated list of parts or points.

modes.label: Figure labels
modes.description: The period after FIG in a figure caption before its number.

modes.label: Ordinal markers
modes.description: The ending of 1st when it begins a numbered argument.
